versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the chen-memory-setup skill for Moltbot/Clawdbot.
- Helps users enable and configure persistent memory search to improve agent context retention.
- Provides step-by-step setup for MEMORY.md, memory directory structure, and recommended config options.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for memory search, provider API keys, and context retrieval.
- Offers sample agent instructions to integrate memory search behaviors.
